skills.name: An informal letter to a family member

note.text: An informal letter communicates with someone you know personally. Include an appropriate greeting, a clear purpose, connected paragraphs and a suitable ending. A warm tone does not mean careless spelling or an unclear message. Ask questions relevant to the recipient and organise news so it can be followed. Do not copy private addresses or information into the app; use an imaginary sender and recipient for the exercise.

sections.heading: Understand the ideas
sections.text: An informal letter communicates with someone you know personally. Include an appropriate greeting, a clear purpose, connected paragraphs and a suitable ending. A warm tone does not mean careless spelling or an unclear message. Ask questions relevant to the recipient and organise news so it can be followed. Do not copy private addresses or information into the app; use an imaginary sender and recipient for the exercise.

sections.heading: Apply the ideas locally
sections.text: Original model: Dear Auntie, I hope you are well. Our reading club has started a shared notebook, and I have enjoyed choosing stories for it. I am learning to finish my chores before the study period. How is your garden growing? Please greet the family for me. With love, Bih.

sections.heading: Reason and check
sections.text: Decide why you are writing before choosing the news to include. Give each paragraph a focus, keep pronouns clear and reread the tone from the recipient's position. A model is one possible answer, not a text to copy word for word.

paper_task.prompt: Write an informal letter from an imaginary learner to a relative. Include news about study or family life and a relevant question.
model: Dear Auntie, I hope you are well. Our reading club has started a shared notebook, and I have enjoyed choosing stories for it. I am learning to finish my chores before the study period. How is your garden growing? Please greet the family for me. With love, Bih.
checklist: My greeting and closing suit the relationship.
The body has a clear purpose and connected ideas.
I have checked punctuation, spelling and pronoun references.
